title: Conversion is intentional dealing with another's chattel inconsistent with possessory rights

content.overview: Conversion is intentional dealing with another's chattel inconsistent with possessory rights. Detinue historically concerned wrongful detention. A finder has qualified possessory rights subject to the true owner's superior claim.
content.study:
Conversion is intentional dealing with another's chattel inconsistent with possessory rights. Detinue historically concerned wrongful detention. A finder has qualified possessory rights subject to the true owner's superior claim.\
\
The law of goods distinguishes possession from ownership. Hollins v Fowler illustrates conversion; Armory v Delamirie illustrates a finder's possessory right against a stranger.
